excerpt.zh:
我们陷入出神时，意识卡入了寂静。我们从未见过如此死寂的虚境。

虚空无声。

万物皆灭。
excerpt.en:
As we tilt into trance, our minds are struck with silence. We have never known the Shroud so still.

The void is voiceless.

Everything is gone.
